about_the_game:
"Time Rebuild" is a sci-fi adventure set in an alternate universe, with "romantic simulation" and "narrative-driven adventure" at its core. The game uses a first-person perspective and is filmed with fully dynamic live-action sequences, aiming to deliver the most realistic and immersive experience to players.

In "Time Rebuild", you will:

Take on the role of a hero tasked with the mission of "saving the world," traveling through different eras in search of a way to prevent the apocalypse. Along the way, your destiny becomes intertwined with five women of distinct personalities. Love and betrayal, choices and death—no one knows where their stories will end. And you, you are the one holding the key to it all.

If tomorrow was the end of the world, what would you do?

Would you abandon everything to save the world?

Or choose to spend the last moments with the one you love?

The elegant and radiant childhood friend

The innocent and lively noble maiden

The gentle and intellectual personal maid

The cool, decisive, and sultry secret agent

The mysterious but brilliant girl

The DEMO version opens the "Phantom From Past" chapter. For a full experience, please follow us!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Window10
  • Processor: Intel Core i3 or AMD equivalen
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel UHD Graphics 730
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 15 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Window10
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 or AMD equivalent or above
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce MX570
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 15 GB available space

short_description: In "Time Rebuild", human civilization stands on the brink of destruction. You will become a time-traveling hero, embarking on a journey to save the world while encountering and bonding with women of vastly different appearances and personalities.
supported_languages:
English*, Simplified Chinese*, Traditional Chinese*
*languages with full audio support
